name: dashboard
title: Dashboard: KPIs + sortable table
description: A dashboard view with a period switch (<Tabs>), a responsive KPI grid (ui/kpi: label, value, change vs previous period with an accessible direction) and a sortable data table component (comp/data-table: column headers are buttons, aria-sort, empty state). Demo numbers come from lib/dashboard-data.jsbrain; swap it for an api() resource.
notes: Uses its own comp/data-table instead of the kit <Table>, which currently fails `brain build` (B0116). Link /dashboard from the nav.
